messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide you can follow to get your acoustic guitar sold quickly—and hopefully at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1️⃣ Inspect & Clean** | Give it a thorough cleaning—wipe down strings, fretboard, body, and hardware. Check for cracks, loose screws, or other damage. Replace worn-out parts if needed. | A well-maintained guitar looks more appealing and fetches a higher price. | | **2️⃣ Determine Condition** | Classify as *New/Like New*, *Excellent*, *Good*, *Fair*, or *Needs Repair*. Be honest – buyers appreciate transparency. | Accurate descriptions reduce returns and build trust. | | **3️⃣ Research Market Value** | Search recent sales on eBay, Reverb, Etsy, Amazon, and local classifieds for the same make/model/year. Take note of prices after fees/shipping. | Helps set a realistic asking price. | | **4️⃣ Set Your Price** | Use the “midpoint” strategy: list slightly above what similar listings ask so you still leave room for negotiation. For example, if comparable units average $350–$400, start around $375. | Gives you leverage while staying competitive. | | **5️⃣ Capture High‑Quality Photos** | • Front view
• Back view
• Close‑up of headstock, neck, bridge, pickups (if applicable)
• Any visible flaws or unique features | Great visuals attract serious buyers faster. | | **6️⃣ Write a Clear Listing Description** | Include:
- Brand, model, year, wood types
- String gauge, pickup type (if electric)
- Current tuning status
- Recent maintenance history
- Reason for selling
- Shipping terms / local pick‑ups | Detailed information reduces back‑and‑forth questions. | | **7️⃣ Choose Where to Sell** | • **Online marketplaces:** eBay, Reverb, Etsy, Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp.
• **Local classifieds:** Craigslist, Nextdoor.
• **Music shops:** Many retailers buy used gear or offer consignment services. | Each platform has pros/cons regarding reach, fees, and buyer demographics. | | **8️⃣ Decide on Payment Method** | PayPal Goods & Services, Venmo, Cash App, bank transfer, or cash for local transactions. Avoid wire transfers unless absolutely sure. | Protects both parties from fraud. | | **9️⃣ Handle Shipping Safely** | • Pack in a sturdy cardboard box with foam inserts or bubble wrap.
• Label clearly (“Fragile”).
• Get insurance up to the value of the guitar.
• Ship via USPS Priority Mail Flat Rate Box or UPS Ground. | Reduces risk of damage during transit. | | 🔟 Stay Safe During Local Meet‑Ups | • Meet in public places (coffee shop, library).
• Bring a friend if possible.
• Verify payment before handing over the instrument. | Minimizes theft or scams. | --- ### Quick Tips & Common Pitfalls | Tip | Explanation | |-----|-------------| | **Use “Reputable Sellers” tags** | On sites like Reverb, marking yourself as a verified seller boosts credibility. | | **Offer a return window** | Even a short 14‑day policy builds confidence but keep conditions clear (buyer pays return postage). | | **Avoid “too good to be true” offers** | If someone offers far above market rate immediately, verify their identity first. | | **Keep records** | Save receipts for repairs or upgrades—you may need them for warranty claims later. | | **Consider bundling accessories** | Adding original case, strap, tuner, or extra strings can increase perceived value. | --- #### Example Listing Snippet ``` Title: Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar - Excellent Condition, 2019 Model Description: Selling my gently-used Yamaha FG800 (2019). Body made of spruce top and mahogany back/necks. Strings replaced last month (D’Addario GHS EX). No scratches or dents. Tuned to standard EADGBE. Comes with original hard shell case, strap, and a D’Addario tuner. Perfect for beginners or intermediate players looking for reliable tone without breaking the bank. Price: $325 USD (Negotiable) Shipping: Will ship within 48 hrs using insured priority mail. Buyer covers shipping cost. Local pick-up available in [City] upon request. Payment accepted via PayPal Goods & Services or Venmo ($10 fee). Feel free to DM me with any questions! Thank you 😊 ``` --- ### Final Checklist Before You List ☑️ Clean & inspect ☑️ Photograph all angles ☑️ Draft detailed description ☐ Research current market rates ☐ Pick preferred platform(s) ☐ Prepare packaging materials Once everything's ready, hit publish and watch those inquiries roll in! If you'd like help drafting a specific listing text or choosing between platforms, let me know—I’m happy to tailor suggestions further. Happy selling!
message.reasoning:
The user asks "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We need to provide guidance: listing platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace), condition assessment, pricing research, photos, description, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention local music stores trade-in programs.

We don't have to call the tool because it's about tuning an instrument; not relevant here. So just respond with helpful info.
